evidence.title: NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands

summary: NVIDIA's new TensorRT Model Connect tool, now in public preview, enables developers to convert Hugging Face models to native C++ inference with just two commands. This streamlines AI deployment by reducing complexity and improving performance.
title: NVIDIA Launches TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview for Simplified AI Inference
